title: How 5 NEW Starters Will DEFINE the 2026 Cleveland Browns Offensive Line Gamble
description:
The Cleveland Browns are attempting something that might be unprecedented in NFL history: starting five completely new offensive linemen in Week 1 of the 2026 season. After losing Joel Bitonio, Wyatt Teller, Jack Conklin, and Ethan Pocic to free agency, Cleveland rebuilt the entire position through trades (Tytus Howard), free agency (Elgton Jenkins, Zion Johnson), and the draft (Spencer Fano, Austin Barber, Parker Brailsford). We break down how GM Andrew Berry assembled this new unit, analyze whether rookie sensation Spencer Fano can handle left tackle from Day One, examine the veterans' injury concerns, and explore the historical stakes of replacing all five starters at once. Can Todd Monken and new OL coach George Warhop get these five strangers to gel in time for Week 1? This gamble could define the Browns' entire 2026 season.
